content:
While the brand-new Mac mini and Mac Studio are stealing the spotlight, Apple today also unveiled an updated version of its polishing cloth. In an era where everything is getting more expensive, the new polishing cloth has actually dropped in price to US$9 (down from US$19).

It's not yet known what changes have been made to the new polishing cloth. Apple's product description for the new version is identical to the old one:

Apple launched the polishing cloth in October 2021, and it sold out almost instantly. Although the product has become an internet meme, it is genuinely a very useful polishing cloth, ideal for cleaning your Apple devices.

You can order this "new" polishing cloth from Apple's official website today for US$9. When I tell you to place your order quickly, I'm not entirely joking, because it's very likely to sell out fast.

If you want to own a piece of Apple history, the original polishing cloth is still available on Amazon for US$19.
